text: Ledger: expense lists become ledgers with expense, income and transfer entries (design)

Done: server (T-242), colours (T-241), web (T-245), Android (T-246) are on main and the gate is green. Not released: this ships as 3.0.0 (protocol 3). Known: web uses radio buttons for the type choice, Android a segmented control; existing 'Settlement' entries recorded as expenses stay counted as spending until edited to Transfer.
